newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk, Greek Cypriot soldiers clash in buffer zone.
newsitem.headline: Turk, Greek Cypriot soldiers clash in buffer zone.

text.p: Turkish Cypriot and Greek Cypriot soldiers clashed in the buffer zone dividing the island on Thursday after the Greek Cypriots attempted to pull down a Turkish flag, Turkey's state-run Anatolian news agency reported.

The agency said the five armed Greek Cypriots fled after Turkish Cypriot soldiers intervened to stop them lowering a Turkish flag at a sentry post in the Akincilar area. The agency gave no casualty details.
